title: Local, Commercial, and Hybrid Models
youtube_title: Local, Commercial, or Hybrid? Where Your AI Agent Should Run | The Agentic Crew, Ch. 12
description: Where your coding agent's model runs is really a decision about trust, cost and capability. This chapter weighs frontier and local models honestly and shows how agent costs spiral and how to cap them. It ends with routing: the right model for each step of the work.
